title: How guard denials are recorded
note: Guards never emit HarnessToolCallDenied. Each guard returns a plain deny reason in HookDecision.message and check identity in audit_fields["check_id"]. guard_denial_identity binds the footer and registered id without parsing JSON; decision_render alone builds Claude, Codex and Cursor output. Guards never read their warn/deny mode: the runner's lint-config mode gate (mode_gate) alone stamps policy_mode and turns a warn-configured deny into a non-blocking warn. The shared hook runner records one row per denial, warn or declared suppression_attempted outcome, after the mode gate and check-id binding. The relay's client-local subset records through the denial-audit route; the hooks route records its own pre-dispatch refusals. Close-out counts these rows with yoke events query --event-name HarnessToolCallDenied. Source/unit evidence is not deployed harness proof.
